```{r}
mapping_path <- "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv"
targeted_mapping <- read_targeted_analyte_mapping(mapping_path)
plot_categories <- c("TraceElements", "Phenols", "Phthalates", "PAH", "PCB", "Parabens", "Smoking", "Pesticides", "VOCs", "FlameRetardants", "PFAS")
targeted_category_lookup <- targeted_mapping %>% dplyr::filter(Category %in% plot_categories) %>% dplyr::select(Code, Category) %>% dplyr::distinct()
theme_codes <- targeted_theme_codes(targeted_mapping)
get_theme <- function(category_name) if (category_name %in% names(theme_codes)) unique(theme_codes[[category_name]]) else character()
Trace_Elements_Theme <- get_theme("TraceElements")
Phenols_Theme <- get_theme("Phenols")
PAH_Theme <- get_theme("PAH")
Phthalates_Theme <- get_theme("Phthalates")
Parabens_Theme <- get_theme("Parabens")
Smoking_Theme <- get_theme("Smoking")
Inflam_Theme <- get_theme("Inflammation")
Pesticide_Theme <- get_theme("Pesticides")
VOC_Theme <- get_theme("VOCs")
OXID_Theme <- get_theme("OxidativeStress")
PFAS_Theme <- get_theme("PFAS")
Flame_Retardant_Theme <- get_theme("FlameRetardants")
PCB_Theme <- get_theme("PCB")
Other_Theme <- character()
add_plot_category <- function(data, code_col = "Outcome") dplyr::left_join(data, targeted_category_lookup, by = stats::setNames("Code", code_col))
```

```{r}
std_study <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_remove(x, '[_]\\w+|:')  # CHECK: ensure this collapse is intended
}
# UNIT CONVERSION (2026-08-11, CODE_AUDIT_2026-08-11.md section 1.1).
# The local to_ng_per_mL() removed here ended in `TRUE ~ value`, so mg/dL,
# ug/mL, ng/g, pmol/mL, nM and kg/m3 fell through UNCONVERTED and were treated
# as ng/mL -- 39,475 rows (5.9%), wrong by factors of 10^3 to 10^6.
local({
  cands <- c("../harmonization_helpers.R", "harmonization_helpers.R",
             "Coding/Paper1_Submission2/harmonization_helpers.R")
  hit <- cands[file.exists(cands)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("Cannot locate harmonization_helpers.R")
  source(hit[[1]], local = FALSE)
})
Child_Data_Targeted <- Targeted_Data_All %>%
  filter(!is.na(Child_PID)) %>%                           # keep child samples
  mutate(
    Units = if_else(is.na(Units), "ng/mL", Units),        # default units
    Concentration = to_ng_per_mL(Concentration, Units)    # normalize units
  ) %>%
  select(-Mat_PID) %>%                                    # not needed for child
  filter(!is.na(Analyte_Code)) %>%                        # require analyte code
  group_by(Study, Child_PID, Analyte_Code) %>%            # average replicates
  summarise(Concentration = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

child_analytes <- sort(unique(Child_Data_Targeted$Analyte_Code))  # vector of analytes

# Build a list of per-analyte wide data.frames keyed by Child_PID ---------
child_list_Targeted <- purrr::map(
  child_analytes,
  ~ Child_Data_Targeted %>%
    filter(Analyte_Code == .x) %>%                         # one analyte
    mutate(Study = std_study(Study)) %>%                   # standardize label
    select(Study, Child_PID, Analyte_Code, Concentration) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Analyte_Code, values_from = Concentration) %>%
    select(Child_PID, Study, all_of(.x))                   # only current analyte col
) %>%
  rlang::set_names(child_analytes)

# MATERNAL targeted data: long -> wide per-analyte list -------------------
Mat_Data_Targeted <- Targeted_Data_All %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mat_PID)) %>%                              # keep maternal samples
  select(-Child_PID) %>%
  mutate(
    Units = if_else(is.na(Units), "ng/mL", Units),
    Concentration = to_ng_per_mL(Concentration, Units)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Analyte_Code)) %>%
  group_by(Study, Mat_PID, Analyte_Code) %>%
  summarise(Concentration = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace(., is.infinite(.), NA_real_)))  

mat_analytes <- sort(unique(Mat_Data_Targeted$Analyte_Code))

mat_list_Targeted <- purrr::map(
  mat_analytes,
  ~ Mat_Data_Targeted %>%
    filter(Analyte_Code == .x) %>%
    mutate(Study = std_study(Study)) %>%
    select(Study, Mat_PID, Analyte_Code, Concentration) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Analyte_Code, values_from = Concentration) %>%
    select(Mat_PID, Study, all_of(.x))
) %>%
  rlang::set_names(mat_analytes)



Child_Sample_Yr <- Targeted_Data_All %>%
  filter(!is.na(Child_PID)) %>% 
  select(-Mat_PID) %>%                                   
  group_by(Child_PID,Sample_Collection_Year) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) 

Mat_Sample_Yr <- Targeted_Data_All %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Mat_PID)) %>% 
  select(-Child_PID) %>%                                   
  group_by(Mat_PID,Sample_Collection_Year) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())
# Split SDOH into child and maternal panels -------------------------------
```

```{r}

studies <- paste0(c("DCHS","ELEMENT"),collapse = "|")

Mapping <- bind_rows(DCHS_SDOH %>% dplyr::select(Mat_PID,Child_PID) %>% mutate(Study = "DCHS_Targeted"),
                     ELEMENT_SDOH %>% dplyr::select(Mat_PID,Child_PID) %>% mutate(Study = "ELEMENT_Targeted"))


Child_Data <- Child_Data_Targeted %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Study, studies)) %>% 
  rename(Concentration_Child = Concentration)

Mat_Data <- Mat_Data_Targeted %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Study, studies)) %>% 
  rename(Concentration_Mat = Concentration) 

child_analytes <- unique(Child_Data$Analyte_Code)
mat_analytes <- unique(Mat_Data$Analyte_Code)

All_Data <- Mat_Data_Targeted %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Study, studies)) %>% 
  rename(Concentration_Mat = Concentration) %>% 
  left_join(.,Mapping,by = c("Mat_PID","Study")) %>% 
  left_join(.,Child_Data, by = c("Child_PID","Study","Analyte_Code")) %>% 
  mutate(Conc_Diff = abs(Concentration_Mat - Concentration_Child)) %>% 
  left_join(.,Mat_Sample_Yr, by = "Mat_PID")

params <- All_Data %>%
  #dplyr::filter(Study == "DCHS_Targeted") %>% 
  summarise(
    global_mean = mean(c(Concentration_Mat, Concentration_Child), na.rm = TRUE),
    global_sd   = sd(c(Concentration_Mat, Concentration_Child), na.rm = TRUE)
  )



plot_data <- All_Data %>% 
  #dplyr::filter(Study == "DCHS_Targeted") %>% 
  bind_cols(params) %>% 
  mutate(
    log_ratio = log1p(Concentration_Child) - log1p(Concentration_Mat)
  ) %>% 
  mutate( highlight = case_when(
      log_ratio >= quantile(log_ratio, 0.90,na.rm = T) ~ "High",
      log_ratio <= quantile(log_ratio, 0.10,na.rm = T) ~ "Low",
      TRUE                                   ~ "Normal"
    )
) %>% 
    add_plot_category(code_col = "Analyte_Code") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Category))
```

```{r}
plot_data_vi2 %>% 
dplyr::filter(Analyte_Code == "PHEN9") %>% 
  View

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Presentation fixes (2026-08):
##  1. Analytes are ordered by median log ratio instead of by code. Unordered,
##     the 34 violins read as an undifferentiated picket fence; ordered, the
##     mother-favouring -> child-favouring gradient is the panel's message.
##  2. fatten raised from 0.7 so the median line is actually visible -- at 0.7
##     the central estimate disappeared and only the range registered.
##  3. The x range moved from scale_x_continuous(limits=) to coord_flip(ylim=).
##     `limits` DROPS out-of-range rows before the violin and boxplot
##     statistics are computed; 10 observations across COTT/MEPB/HPMA/HCOTT
##     were being silently deleted from their own summaries. coord zooms
##     instead, so the statistics see every point.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_data_vi2 <- plot_data_vi2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Analyte_Code = forcats::fct_reorder(Analyte_Code, log_ratio,
                                        .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

vi_plot <- ggplot(plot_data_vi2, aes(x = log_ratio, y = Analyte_Code, color = Category, fill = Category)) +
  # smooth, neutral violins
  geom_violin(
    #fill = "grey90",
    #color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.4,
    outlier.size = 0.5,
    outlier.alpha = 0.6,
    fatten = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log(Child / Mother)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Child–Mother Log Ratios Across Exposures"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mypal) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  #coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3)) +  # e.g., focus on -3 to +3

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(-5, -3, -1, 0, 1, 3, 5),
  labels = c(
    "148× Mother",
    "20× Mother",
    "2.7× Mother",
    "Equal",
    "2.7× Child",
    "20× Child",
    "148× Child"
  )
) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 13
    ),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    # hjust/vjust anchor the rotated analyte labels at their tick instead of
    # letting them rotate about their centre -- that overlap is what fused
    # PHEN2 and PHEN3 into an unreadable "PHEN2PHEN3" in Figure 2D.
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 11)

  ) +
  # NB: coord_flip limits are named for the PRE-flip aesthetics, so the log
  # ratio range belongs in xlim -- passing it as ylim clamps the discrete
  # analyte axis instead and silently drops most of the violins.
  coord_flip(xlim = c(-5, 5))


pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Child_Adult_vi.pdf",height = 6,width = 10)
print(vi_plot)
dev.off()
save(vi_plot, file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/vi_plot.RData")
```

```{r}
pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Child_Adult_Scatter.pdf",height = 6,width = 6)


fit <- lm(log10(Concentration_Child) ~ log10(Concentration_Mat) + Sample_Collection_Year,
          data = plot_data_vi2 %>% dplyr::filter(Study == "DCHS_Targeted"))

summary(fit)
el_data <-  plot_data_vi2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Study == "ELEMENT_Targeted") %>% 
  #drop_na() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Concentration_Mat >0)

fit <- lm(log10(Concentration_Child) ~ log10(Concentration_Mat),
          data = el_data)

summary(fit)

plot_data_scatter <- plot_data_vi2%>% 
  dplyr::filter(Concentration_Mat >0)
# The subtitle's slope and R2 were typed in by hand ("0.66 (R2 = 0.57)") and so
# never moved when the data did (e.g. the 2026-11-03 ug/g creatinine rebuild,
# which shifts DCHS relative to ELEMENT). Compute them from the same log-log
# fit that geom_smooth(method = "lm") draws on the log10 axes below.
mc_fit <- lm(log10(Concentration_Child) ~ log10(Concentration_Mat),
             data = dplyr::filter(plot_data_scatter, Concentration_Child > 0))
mc_slope <- unname(coef(mc_fit)[2])
mc_r2    <- summary(mc_fit)$r.squared
mat_child_scatter <- ggplot(plot_data_scatter,
       aes(x = Concentration_Mat, 
           y = Concentration_Child)) +
  
  # Points, drawn as two layers rather than one.
  # ELEMENT is 957 observations against DCHS's 22,382 -- 4% of the panel. In a
  # single layer ggplot draws them in row order, so ELEMENT ended up buried
  # under the DCHS mass and its colour was effectively never visible. DCHS is
  # laid down first and kept faint; ELEMENT is painted over it, denser and
  # slightly larger because it has two orders of magnitude fewer points to
  # spend on visibility.
  geom_point(data = function(d) d[d$Study == "DCHS_Targeted", ],
             aes(color = Study), alpha = 0.16, size = 0.7, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = function(d) d[d$Study == "ELEMENT_Targeted", ],
             aes(color = Study), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.3, stroke = 0) +

  # 1:1 Reference Line
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 0.5,
              color = "grey40") +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.4,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Log scales with cleaner breaks.
  # label_number(auto = TRUE) was picking its own decimal count per axis, which
  # printed 0.01 as "0" on x while y showed "100.00", and inserted a thin-space
  # thousands separator ("10 000"). Fixed formatting on both axes instead.
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = function(x) trimws(formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 3, big.mark = ",")),
    breaks = scales::log_breaks()
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = function(x) trimws(formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 3, big.mark = ",")),
    breaks = scales::log_breaks()
  ) +

  # `mypal` is the exposure-CATEGORY palette; this scale maps Study, so no name
  # ever matched and every cohort silently fell through to na.value grey --
  # the "Cohort" legend was labelling a distinction the plot never drew.
  # Only DCHS and ELEMENT contribute paired mother-child measurements.
  # Green vs magenta rather than green vs purple: purple sat too close to the
  # green mass to separate at point size, and the pair has to stay legible
  # under red-green colour blindness.
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("DCHS_Targeted" = "#1B7837", "ELEMENT_Targeted" = "#E7298A"),
    labels = c("DCHS_Targeted" = "DCHS (South Africa)",
               "ELEMENT_Targeted" = "ELEMENT (Mexico City)"),
    name = "Cohort",
    na.value = "grey60"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1, linewidth = 0))) +

  labs(
    title = "Child vs Maternal Exposure",
    subtitle = paste0(sprintf("Grey dashed: 1:1.  Black: OLS fit, slope %.2f (R2 = %.2f).", mc_slope, mc_r2),
                      if (mc_slope < 1) "\nSlope < 1: child concentrations rise less than proportionally with maternal."
                      else "\nSlope >= 1: child concentrations rise at least proportionally with maternal."),
    x = "Maternal Concentration (ng/mL)",
    y = "Child Concentration (ng/mL)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, colour = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10)
  )
print(mat_child_scatter)
dev.off()
save(mat_child_scatter, file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/mat_child_scatter.RData")

save(plot_data_vi2, file = "../../../HHEAR_Man1_App/Mat_Child_Data.RData")
```

```{r}
Mat_Conc <- plot_data_vi2 %>% 
  group_by(Analyte_Code) %>% 
  summarise(mean_mat_conc = mean(Concentration_Mat,na.rm = T)) 

Child_Conc <- plot_data_vi2 %>% 
  group_by(Analyte_Code) %>% 
  summarise(mean_child_conc = mean(Concentration_Child,na.rm = T)) 

All_Conc <- left_join(Mat_Conc,Child_Conc,by = "Analyte_Code")  %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_mat_conc, mean_child_conc),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Mean_Conc"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode(Group,
                   "mean_mat_conc" = "Maternal",
                   "mean_child_conc" = "Child")
  )

pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Child_Adult_Mean_Bar.pdf",height = 6,width = 6)
child_adult_mean_bar <- ggplot(All_Conc,
       aes(y = Analyte_Code, x = abs(log(Mean_Conc)), fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Maternal" = "steelblue",
                               "Child" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    x = "log(Mean Concentration)",
    y = "Exposure",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Mean Maternal vs Child Concentrations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(child_adult_mean_bar)
dev.off()
save(child_adult_mean_bar, file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/child_adult_mean_bar.RData")
```

```{r}
result <- plot_data_vi2 %>%
  mutate(log_ratio = log(Concentration_Child) - log(Concentration_Mat)) %>%
  group_by(Analyte_Code) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_log_ratio = median(log_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    fold_change = exp(median_log_ratio),
    p_value = wilcox.test(log_ratio, mu = 0)$p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Sig_10 = ifelse(p_adj <=0.05,1,0))
```
